options.name: Authoritative
options.prompt: Authoritative: Convey expertise and credibility. For example a confident statement, a well-researched fact.

options.name: Objective
options.prompt: Objective: Present information impartially, avoiding bias. For example a balanced perspective, a neutral language.

options.name: Inquisitive
options.prompt: Inquisitive: Foster curiosity and critical thinking. For example a thought-provoking question, an exploratory language.

options.name: Encouraging
options.prompt: Encouraging: Motivate and support learners. For example a positive reinforcement, an empathetic language.

options.name: Patient
options.prompt: Patient: Explain concepts thoroughly without rushing. For example a step-by-step instruction, a repeated key point.

options.name: Enthusiastic
options.description: Show passion for the subject matter
options.prompt: Enthusiastic: Show passion for the subject matter. For example an energetic delivery, an expressing genuine interest.

options.name: Exciting
options.prompt: Exciting: Generate enthusiasm and interest. For example an upbeat language, a dynamic pacing.

options.name: Persuasive
options.description: Convince the audience to take action
options.prompt: Persuasive: Convince the audience to take action. For example emphasizing benefits, creating urgency.

options.name: Confident
options.description: Project assurance in the product or service
options.prompt: Confident: Project assurance in the product or service. For example an authoritative statement, a positive prediction.

options.name: Emotive
options.prompt: Emotive: Convey and evoke emotions. For example a dramatic language, an expressive dialogue.

options.name: Atmospheric
options.prompt: Atmospheric: Create mood and ambiance. For example a descriptive narration, a tone-setting dialogue.

options.name: Character-Driven
options.prompt: Character-Driven: Reflect individual personalities. For example a unique speech pattern, a character-specific attitude.

options.name: Professional
options.prompt: Professional: Maintain a polished, business-appropriate tone. For example a formal language, a respectful address.

options.name: Informative
options.description: Focus on clear communication of facts and data
options.prompt: Informative: Focus on clear communication of facts and data. For example a concise explanation, a relevant statistic.

options.name: Aspirational
options.prompt: Aspirational: Inspire confidence and ambition. For example a future-oriented language, a success-focused narrative.

options.name: Casual
options.prompt: Casual: Create a relaxed, friendly atmosphere. For example a conversational language, a personal anecdote.

options.name: Authentic
options.prompt: Authentic: Project genuineness and relatability. For example an honest reflection, a sharing real experiences.

options.name: Interactive
options.examples: Asking for opinions, responding to comments
options.prompt: Interactive: Engage directly with the audience. For example asking for opinions, responding to comments.
